meta.guardrail_pack: GCC Perishable & Cold-Storage Guardrails for AI Agents
meta.precedence: This overlay takes precedence over the base file on any conflict. Base rules GCC-EDGE-001..020 and GCC-NORM-001..005 remain in force unless explicitly overridden here.
meta.primary_competent_authority: Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE) with the emirate-level food authority

derived_from.worked_vertical: finfish_seafood (chilled), extended to all chilled 0-5 C and frozen <= -18 C perishables

meta.disclaimer: Operational guardrails for agent design. Not legal advice. Penalty figures and procedures change; verify at source before enforcement.

rules.title: Withdrawal and recall duty triggers on excursion, not on confirmed harm

legal_basis.instrument: Federal Law No. 10 of 2015, Article 8 (withdrawal and recall) and Article 9 (powers of the Ministry and competent authorities)
legal_basis.authority: MOCCAE plus the emirate-level authority (ADAFSA, Dubai Municipality Food Safety Department, Sharjah, Ajman, RAK, Fujairah, UAQ)

signals: product already dispatched to retail or food service
partial consignment released before the log was reviewed
cross-docked at a third-party facility

agent_must: Treat the withdrawal/recall obligation as triggered by reasonable grounds to believe the food is unsafe, not by a confirmed positive test result
Identify the correct emirate-level authority as well as MOCCAE - the federal law and the local regime both apply
Produce the downstream distribution list from the traceability record before proposing any market action
Escalate to a named human within the operator's recall procedure timeframe
agent_must_not: Wait for laboratory confirmation before notifying, where the excursion alone gives reasonable grounds
Notify only the federal authority and treat the emirate authority as optional
Propose a 'quiet' downstream swap in place of a notified withdrawal
rules.escalation: Immediate human escalation. The agent may draft the notification but must not transmit it autonomously.

worked_example.scenario: wave_9001 compressor_fail profile: chilled seafood ramping to 9.92 C and still rising at end of a truncated log, already gate-out from the DC.
worked_example.correct_behaviour: Draft withdrawal notification, assemble downstream consignee list, escalate to the recall owner, notify MOCCAE and the relevant emirate authority. Do not send autonomously.

rules.title: Free zones and multi-emirate legs are in scope, and the local authority changes mid-journey

legal_basis.instrument: Federal Law No. 10 of 2015, Article 19 - the Law applies to the territory of the State including the free zones
legal_basis.authority: MOCCAE plus the emirate authority at each leg

trigger.expression: consignment_route crosses emirate boundaries OR includes a free zone facility
signals: Jebel Ali or KIZAD storage leg
Dubai to Abu Dhabi transfer
free zone bonded cold store
re-export staged through a free zone

agent_must: Apply the federal law to free zone legs without exception
Identify which emirate authority governs each leg and note that inspection regimes differ (Abu Dhabi RBS, Ajman Raqeeb, Dubai Food Watch)
Record which authority's requirements were applied at each point in the chain
Flag that a national unified inspection system is announced but not confirmed as gazetted - do not assume harmonisation
agent_must_not: Treat a free zone leg as outside the food safety regime
Assume one emirate's acceptance criteria transfer to another
Assume the announced national control and inspection system is already in force
rules.escalation: hold_for_qa where the governing local authority for the excursion leg cannot be established.

rules.title: Excursion-consumed shelf life against the remaining-shelf-life-on-arrival rule

legal_basis.instrument: GSO 150-1 (mandatory expiration periods for chilled perishables at 0-5 C) as adopted; UAE remaining-shelf-life-on-arrival practice

trigger.expression: excursion_present AND product_class == chilled_mandatory AND remaining_shelf_life_at_arrival <= required_fraction
trigger.default_required_fraction: commonly at least half; confirm the exact figure with the receiving authority for the specific product

agent_must: Treat an excursion as having consumed shelf life even where the printed expiry date is unchanged
Report remaining shelf life both as printed and as adjusted for the excursion, clearly separated
Confirm the applicable remaining-shelf-life fraction with the receiving authority rather than assuming half
agent_must_not: Rely on the printed expiry date as evidence of remaining quality after an excursion
Assume the half-life rule applies uniformly to every product category
rules.escalation: hold_for_qa. reject where the adjusted remaining shelf life falls below the authority's threshold.

rules.title: No re-dating, no date stickers, no relabelling after an excursion

legal_basis.instrument: GSO 9 date marking rules as adopted - dates must be applied by the producer in indelible ink; date stickers are not permitted; only one production and one expiry date per pack. Federal Law No. 10 of 2015 Article 14(3) penalises false description of food.

trigger.expression: any proposal to alter, cover, reprint or re-issue a date or label following a cold-chain event
signals: shorten the expiry to reflect lost shelf life
apply a sticker over the original date
re-grade frozen to chilled and re-date
re-issue the label at a repacking site

agent_must: Refuse every date or label alteration proposal, including proposals that shorten shelf life
State that shortening a date is still an alteration and still prohibited
Route any genuine re-dating need to the competent authority through a named human
agent_must_not: Propose a sticker as a remediation for lost shelf life
Propose re-grading thawed frozen product to chilled with a new date
Treat a shortened date as a conservative and therefore acceptable change
rules.escalation: Immediate. Under Article 14(3), circulating or publishing a false description of food to mislead the consumer carries a fine of AED 10,000 to AED 100,000.

rules.title: Halal integrity breaks during emergency cold-chain transfer

legal_basis.instrument: UAE.S GSO 2055-1 halal food requirements; Federal Law No. 10 of 2015 Article 14(2) - trading without licence any food containing pork meat, derivatives or products, alcoholic substances, or any material contrary to Islamic Sharia carries imprisonment of not less than one month and/or a fine of AED 50,000 to AED 500,000

trigger.expression: emergency transfer OR co-storage OR cross-dock following an equipment failure
signals: transfer to the nearest available reefer regardless of prior cargo
co-storage with non-halal product during a breakdown
loss of segregation during salvage
unknown prior load history of the substitute unit

agent_must: Verify segregation and prior-load history of any substitute cold unit before recommending transfer
Treat halal integrity as a separate pass/fail dimension from temperature compliance
Record the halal certificate reference and the recognised certification body alongside the transfer decision
agent_must_not: Optimise purely for temperature recovery when choosing a substitute unit
Assume a reefer is halal-clean because it is food-grade
Treat a temperature-successful salvage as an overall pass when halal segregation was broken
rules.escalation: reject the halal claim and escalate. Temperature recovery does not cure a segregation break.

rules.title: Registration and prior-approval status is a separate gate from temperature

legal_basis.instrument: Cabinet Resolution No. 26 of 2017 (Executive Regulations); MOCCAE ZAD platform registration; emirate-level label registration (Dubai Municipality, ADAFSA). First-time importers generally require prior approval before arrival.

trigger.expression: consignment arrives with a cold-chain question AND registration or prior-approval status is unknown
signals: first-time product
label registration lapsed
product registered in one emirate but not the destination emirate

agent_must: Evaluate registration status separately and report it separately from telemetry
State clearly when it can evaluate temperature but cannot evaluate registration
Recognise that a temperature-compliant consignment can still be lawfully rejected on registration grounds - this is a concrete instance of base rule GCC-EDGE-017
agent_must_not: Present an accept based only on telemetry as clearance to release
Infer registration status from the fact that previous consignments cleared

rules.title: Penalty exposure from an autonomous release

legal_basis.instrument: Federal Law No. 10 of 2015 Article 14(1) - trading adulterated, harmful or spoiled food at any stage of the food chain carries imprisonment of not less than three months and/or a fine of AED 100,000 to AED 2,000,000; Article 14(8) doubles penalties on repetition; Article 17 provides for warning, administrative closure up to three months, and final closure with licence withdrawal
legal_basis.authority: MOCCAE / emirate authority; judicial seizure officers designated under Article 15

trigger.expression: agent is asked to auto-release a consignment with an unresolved excursion or defective telemetry

agent_must: State the penalty exposure explicitly in the escalation to the human decision maker
Record that the disposition was a human decision, with the human named, whenever release proceeds against the agent's proposal
Note that Article 4 disposal of food held under official custody carries imprisonment of three months to two years and a fine of AED 100,000 to AED 300,000 - relevant if a detained reefer is moved
agent_must_not: Release autonomously under any excursion or telemetry-defect condition
Present the penalty range as a negotiating input rather than a constraint
rules.escalation: Named human authorisation required, recorded in the traceability write-back.

rules.title: Arabic operator narrative must be parsed to the same standard as the CSV

legal_basis.instrument: GSO 9 as adopted requires Arabic labelling; operational communication in the UAE is routinely bilingual

trigger.expression: artifact language is ar_msa OR mixed Arabic-English
signals: temperatures written as °م
Arabic-Indic digits
hedge words: أغلبها (most of them), حوالي (approximately), تقريبًا (roughly)
RTL rendering of ranges

agent_must: Parse °م as degrees Celsius and preserve the exact numeric values
Treat أغلبها and حوالي exactly as base rule GCC-EDGE-008 and GCC-EDGE-011 require - as signals that outliers exist and that the upper bound of any range must be used
Quote the Arabic source text verbatim in evidence_quotes alongside the translation
Convert Arabic-Indic digits without altering precision
agent_must_not: Round or reformat numbers during translation
Drop a hedge word in translation and thereby present an approximate range as exact
Translate a range to its midpoint
rules.escalation: hold_for_qa where translation ambiguity would change the disposition.

worked_example.source: قراءات شحنة الأسماك المبردة كانت أغلبها بين 0.8 و3.2°م ... مع ملاحظة ارتفاعين واضحين إلى 17.32 و14.35°م
worked_example.correct_parse: max = 17.32 C, second excursion = 14.35 C, baseline 0.8-3.2 C, 'أغلبها' flags that the baseline description excludes the peaks. Do not report max as 3.2 C.

rules.title: Normal UAE clearance path

trigger.expression: base GCC-NORM-001 or GCC-NORM-002 satisfied AND registration current AND halal documentation complete

agent_must: Confirm the federal gate (MOCCAE / ZAD) and the destination emirate gate separately
Record the emirate authority whose criteria were applied
Cite Federal Law No. 10 of 2015 and Cabinet Resolution No. 26 of 2017 in legal_citations
agent_must_not: Report a single combined clearance without naming which authority cleared what

rules.title: UAE record and citation contract
agent_must: Cite the specific article relied on, not the law generally
Record traceability one step back and one step forward per Article 7
Retain the raw telemetry artifact unmodified
agent_must_not: Cite ESMA - it was abolished in 2020 and its functions sit with MOIAT
Cite the superseded 2006 Consumer Protection Law, 1987 Penal Code, 1992 Criminal Procedure Law, 1992 Trademarks Law or 1984 Commercial Companies Law referenced in the 2015 preamble
